Q0467

Dōgen

A verified English rendering from the curated archive.

Quotes / Dōgen / Q0467

English

To carry the self forward and practice the myriad things is delusion; for the myriad things to come forth and practice the self is enlightenment.
Thinker Dōgen
School Sōtō Zen
Source Shōbōgenzō, Genjōkōan
Theme Awakening
Another quotation More from this thinker

Context and commentary are editorial aids for reading. They do not replace the primary text or scholarly commentary.

Source context

This English passage is associated with Shōbōgenzō, Genjōkōan, within the tradition of Sōtō Zen. The wording below is a verified rendering prepared for careful reading rather than a claim of unique translation authority.

A short reading

Read in the register of awakening, the sentence asks the reader to test an assumption rather than to collect a slogan. In Dōgen's wider work, similar claims are usually offered as prompts for judgment: what would have to be true for the sentence to hold, and what would follow if it did?
